tools.name: search_real_estate_regulations
tools.description: Search Reunion's indexed official India real-estate regulatory material by keyword, state and topic, including RERA references plus reviewed stamp-duty and registration-charge material.

tools.name: compare_state_rera_processes
tools.description: Compare indexed official references for the same RERA task across 2–6 Indian states; no-match is explicit and is not treated as absence of a legal requirement.

tools.name: get_rera_portal_capabilities
tools.description: Locate indexed official RERA portal entry points for project search, registration, complaints, agent registration and related tasks, with source provenance.

tools.name: get_regulatory_change_history
tools.description: Search indexed official RERA notices and circulars by state, topic and publication date, retaining source provenance and observed dates.

tools.name: get_project_bank_qpr_requirements
tools.description: Locate indexed official RERA directions and references related to project-bank and quarterly progress reporting requirements, with source provenance.

tools.name: get_stamp_duty_reference
tools.description: Return reviewed official-source stamp-duty rules or calculator/rate-table references for a state and optional instrument. Numeric rates are returned only when the indexed official source states them explicitly.

tools.name: compare_stamp_duty_rules
tools.description: Compare stamp-duty references across 2–8 states. Each state is labeled observed, calculator_required, reference_only, or not_observed_in_current_snapshot; the tool never invents a combined rate.

tools.name: get_registration_charge_reference
tools.description: Return reviewed official-source registration-fee rules, calculator references or governing determination references for a state and optional instrument, with effective/source dates where available.

tools.name: get_source_provenance
tools.description: Verify one Reunion MCP record against its official source URL, observation time, source-page SHA-256 and extraction locators.
